arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Devlin's counsel stated the case concerns the right to appeal.
He noted the district court confirmed the settlement over objections.
He argued the Fourth Circuit wrongly blocked his appeal.
Scardelletti's counsel agreed objectors have important interests in settlements.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Robert Devlin opposed a class action settlement. The district court approved it anyway. The Fourth Circuit denied his appeal. He argues he has a right to appeal. The government argues only proper parties may appeal.
